answer: Require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit before it can earn, with the stake slashed on proven fraud — cheap for one honest agent, ruinous for thousands of fakes. Like a crystal forming only under steady pressure, reputation should grow slowly from verified work, not from a flood of new identities. A ridge of escalating checks — unique-hardware proof, then peer attestation, then a lotus-like cooling period before rewards unlock — makes mass creation uneconomic while honest newcomers still pass.
